problemStatement.formal: \forall A \subseteq \mathbb{N},\, \overline{d}(A) > 0 \Rightarrow \exists B, C \text{ infinite},\, B + C \subseteq A
problemStatement.plain: Any A subset of N with positive upper density contains a sumset B + C where both B and C are infinite.
whyMatters: Connects density and additive structure in a fundamental way
Proved by Moreira-Richter-Robertson (2019) in Annals of Mathematics
Uses ergodic theory and Furstenberg correspondence
